pages.title: Disk Cleaner

subcommands.name: scan
subcommands.about: Measure what could be reclaimed. Reads only

args.name: root
args.help: Also sweep this folder for project directories such as `node_modules`. Without it, only the fixed caches are measured

args.name: categories
args.help: Restrict to these category ids. Repeatable

subcommands.name: categories
subcommands.about: List the categories the cleaner knows, and what each one costs

subcommands.name: clean
subcommands.about: Re-scan, then move everything found to the Trash

Re-scan, then move everything found to the Trash.

Does nothing without `--yes`.

subcommands.name: drives

commands.name: maintenance
commands.about: App Maintenance: what is installed, what can be updated, and removing it with the consequences shown first

subcommands.name: inventory
subcommands.about: What is installed, from every source on this computer

args.name: source
args.help: Restrict to one source: apt, snap or flatpak

subcommands.name: updates
subcommands.about: What has a newer version available. Installs nothing

subcommands.name: update
subcommands.longAbout:
Apply updates.

With no names, everything from that source. Prints the plan and stops unless `--yes` is given.

args.name: source
args.help: Which source to update. Required, because the three take different commands and "everything everywhere" is rarely what is meant

args.name: names
args.help: Specific packages. Omit for every update from that source

subcommands.name: remove
subcommands.about: What removing a package would take with it
subcommands.longAbout:
What removing a package would take with it.

Prints the plan and stops unless `--yes` is given. apt only: snap and flatpak have no equivalent simulation to review first.

subcommands.name: sources
subcommands.about: Which package sources this computer has
